title: Guess the Number in Python!

steps.title: Step 1: Generate a Random Number
steps.explanation: We use the random module to pick a number between 1 and 100.

steps.title: Step 2: Get User Guesses
code_lines: guess = int(input("Guess a number between 1 and 100: "))
steps.explanation: We loop until the user guesses the correct number, asking for input each time.

steps.title: Step 3: Give Feedback
steps.explanation: We check if the guess is too low or too high and give the user feedback.

steps.title: Step 4: Celebrate the Win!
steps.explanation: Once the user guesses correctly, we print a congratulatory message.

steps.title: Try It Yourself!
steps.explanation: Try running this code and see if you can guess the number!
